seed_mapping: hashSeed(H1-seed:<index>); disjoint from previously evaluated H1/H2 seeds
grouping: Actual default catalog role.kind. Assign roles by hashSeed(actorId) modulo catalog roles; rotate catalog index by one from day30. Same assignment and actual role place for all variants.
training: Generate completed LinUCB synthetic ordinary plans using the same rollout. Require H3 verified-contextual, fingerprint-v1 binding, exact reward/features/catalog signatures, unique experience IDs and donor ownership. Fit global and role-kind ridge models on the SAME accepted raw outcomes. No residual/H2 fallback, private memories or live DB.
policy: Blend original .7*personal prediction with .7*prior mean by weight5/(own samples+5); unknown group/action uses supported global fallback, no prior leaves original prediction bit-identical. Role mean shrinks toward global by min(.8, role support/(role support+20)). All other scores/affinity/taste/novelty/gates/emergencies and personal uncertainty unchanged. No prior matrices/samples copied into personal state.
evaluation: Freeze artifact before validation/holdout. Report both candidates on both sets, no parameter selection or retuning from these seeds. Evaluate paired holdout gates against personal baseline per profile; role-vs-global ablation reported separately.

gates.entropy: paired CI95 lower bound of candidate - .8*baseline >=0

secondary_metrics: same-decision personal prediction MSE versus blended prediction MSE
promotion: No automatic installation or policy activation. Failed candidates remain offline; successful offline gates still need explicit runtime artifact/CAS/rollback design and review.
limits: H1/H2 hourly/one-step oracle/stress limitations still apply. No social/P2P/physical authority.
Existing outcome formula has no role-dependent payoff; different role-kind models can only reflect context/action distributions, not establish role specialization.
Catalog grouping is a simulation role-kind grouping, not real occupational expertise.
SHA256 ensures integrity, not external source authenticity; this trainer accepts generated synthetic outcomes only.
